stem.en: Match each question the friends ask about ABC Bakery to the part of the business plan it belongs to.

explanation.en: The book puts selling online under location, a range of prices under pricing, social media under promotion, and perishable goods under challenges and risks. These parts are not steps in an order: a plan answers all of them.

hints.en: Where the goods are sold, including online, is part of location.

text.en: Should we also take orders through a mobile app?
Will cheaper mini cake jars bring in more buyers?
Should we post photos of our cakes on social media?
What do we do with bread that is not sold by evening?
